context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 tested the two NEW features: (1) URL Relevance Tagging - POST /api/training/add-url now accepts optional 'relevance' field (integer 1-6), stores it in DB, returns it in response, and logs it in activity_log with relevance_tag. Frontend has 1-6 button selector below URL input with toggle behavior. (2) Training Activity Log - GET /api/training/activity-log returns entries (url_added, file_uploaded, training_run events), summary stats (feedback counts, training counts, relevance tagged count), and ai_impact (regions/actors/keywords learned from completed training). Frontend shows this in 'Training Activity Log & Impact' card with summary metrics, AI Impact section, and Recent Activity timeline. All existing endpoints (feedback, training queue, insights, progress) continue to work. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_training_relevance_activity_v19.py
